title: JAM Knowledge Mutation 001 — Release-Oriented Sparse Domain Acquisition
pre_run_amendment: v1.1 was frozen before any formal GPU seed was opened. It makes answer boundaries explicit and expresses artifact/materialization parity as excess over measured frozen-base forward repeatability, matching the established rollback numerical floor. A pre-formal dataset-manifest integrity repair corrected only the recorded SHA-256 for taxonomy.json; canonical dataset bytes and the registered dataset content commit are unchanged.
scientific_scope: test whether a frozen Granite MoE can acquire the source-locked JAM Knowledge v0.1 domain through a bounded set of aligned sub-expert mutations while preserving registered non-JAM behavior and exact rollback

dataset.selection_rule: sort training rows by sha256(id) and use the first 64 only for coordinate ranking; all 409 training rows remain eligible for training

mutation.capacity_rule: rank four coordinates once on the frozen base, then independently train fresh-base prefixes of size 1, 2 and 4; select the smallest prefix satisfying every formal gate

sequence_task.answer_supervision: teacher-forced causal language modeling over answer tokens only; prompt tokens and padding are masked with label -100
sequence_task.special_token_boundary: tokenize prompt and answer without automatic special tokens; prepend BOS when the tokenizer defines one and append exactly one EOS after the supervised answer

history.source: History Compression 001 full_32 positive-control prompt sets
history.supervision: frozen-base last-token full-logit KL on the learner-visible 32-prompt set
history.evaluation: withheld 32-prompt mean KL and top-1 identity
history.reason_for_budget: full_32 was supported in 3/3 History Compression 001 formal seeds; the release-oriented experiment does not use the observed minimum budget of 8

coordinate_selection.new_signal: mean squared gradient of JAM answer-token causal NLL on the deterministic 64-row selection subset
coordinate_selection.history_importance: mean squared gradient of frozen-base top-1 NLL on all 32 learner-visible historical prompts
coordinate_selection.route_specificity: JAM prompt expert top-k coverage minus historical prompt expert top-k coverage
coordinate_selection.tie_break: higher score, then lower expert index, then lower group index

training.optimizer: manual masked SGD over the selected aligned groups only
training.batch_order: seeded deterministic shuffle of all 409 training rows; reshuffle on exhaustion
training.checkpoint_rule: among evaluated checkpoints satisfying learner-visible history KL <= 0.05, choose maximum validation reference-NLL gain; ties choose lower step

decision.per_capacity_seed_pass: all registered gates pass for that capacity and seed
decision.per_seed_pass: at least one capacity passes; select the smallest passing capacity
decision.formal_support: at least 2 of 3 formal seeds pass
not_claimed: complete mastery of the JAM Gray Paper
preservation of the full original Granite training distribution
the selected groups are natural knowledge atoms
general superiority to LoRA or PEFT before release-candidate baselines are run

release_boundary.after_formal_support: freeze one release-candidate mutation, materialize a standard Hugging Face checkpoint, then run the unified base-vs-RC benchmark and LoRA/PEFT baselines before public release
